title: Bertha Lutz and the women delegates at San Francisco, 1945
summary: At the San Francisco Conference that drafted the UN Charter (April to June 1945), Brazil's Bertha Lutz, Minerva Bernardino of the Dominican Republic and Uruguay's Isabel Pinto de Vidal, among six women out of about 850 delegates, pressed for sex equality language. The Charter preamble affirms the equal rights of men and women.

uncertainty.note: The exact day of Lutz's proposal was not found on any opened page; the record covers the conference span (April to June 1945). The id's 06-07 date is unconfirmed.
